arabic text:
KHAMOSHIYOH SE HI PUCHO....
IN AASUHO SE HI PUCHO....
KHAMOSHIYOH SE HI PUCHO....
IN AASUHO SE HI PUCHO....
english translation text:
Ask the silence itself…
Ask these tears themselves…
Ask the silence itself…
Ask these tears themselves…

arabic text:
BADE ZULM RAHO MEIN SEHTI RAHI HAI-
YATIMI KE TAHNE YEH SEHTE RAHI HAI-
NAHI MAR ZALIM TAMACHE ISE-
NA KAR DUSHWAAR ISKA JINA-
BAHUT RO CHUKI HAI SAKINA....
ALLAH- BAHUT RO CHUKI HAI SAKINA....2
english translation text:
She endured terrible cruelty along the roads.
She bore the taunts of orphanhood.
Cruel one, do not strike her with another slap;
do not make her life more unbearable.
Sakina has already wept so much.
O Allah—Sakina has already wept so much.

arabic text:
SAFAR MEIN YEH SOWI NA ZINDAAN AAKAR-
UJALA KIYAH HAI YAHA DIL JALAKAR-
PADAR SE JOH BICHDE ASHUR KO-
SUKUN PASAKI PHIR KABHI NA-
BAHUT RO CHUKI HAI SAKINA....
english translation text:
She did not sleep during the journey, nor after reaching the prison.
She lit that darkness by burning her own heart.
Separated from her father on Ashura,
she never again found peace.
Sakina has already wept so much.

arabic text:
MILA DASHT MEIN JAB KE BABA KA LASHA-
LIPAT KAR PADAR SE KIYA KHUB GIRYAH-
WAHA PAHUCHI ZAINAB TOH SHANE KAHA-
SULA DO ISE JAKE BEHNA-
BAHUT RO CHUKI HAI SAKINA....
english translation text:
When she found her father’s body in the desert,
she clung to him and wept intensely.
When Zainab arrived, the Master said:
Sister, take her and put her to sleep.
Sakina has already wept so much.

arabic text:
RASAN DEGAYI HAI NISHANI GALE PAR-
HAY PESHANI ZAKHMI JOH PAYE TEH PATHAR-
NISHA HAI TAMCHO KE RUKSAAR PAR-
MASAYAB SEH ZAKHMI HAI SINA-
BAHUT RO CHUKI HAI SAKINA....
KABHI APNE BABA KE QATIL SE DAR KAR-
english translation text:
The rope has left its mark upon her neck.
Her forehead is wounded where stones struck her.
The marks of slaps remain upon her cheeks;
her chest is wounded by suffering.
Sakina has already wept so much.
At times she trembled before her father’s killer—

arabic text:
KABHI ROYE ZINDAAN MEIN TANHAHIYOH PAR-
KABHI BOLI ZAINAB SE AB GHAR CHALO-
HUWA EK BARAS EK MAHINA-
BAHUT RO CHUKI HAI SAKINA....
english translation text:
At times she cried over the loneliness of the prison.
At times she said to Zainab, ‘Let us go home now.’
A year and a month had passed.
Sakina has already wept so much.

arabic text:
HU MAKTAL KE BAZAAR YAH QAIDKHANA-
SADA DEKE BABA SE KEHTE THI DUKHIYAH-
YATIMI MILE TOH MILE AISE GUM-
KAHI CHAIN SE JEE NA SAKIH NA-
BAHUT RO CHUKI HAI SAKINA....
english translation text:
Whether in the battlefield, marketplace, or prison,
the grieving child kept calling to her father.
Orphanhood brought her such grief
that nowhere could she live in peace.
Sakina has already wept so much.

arabic text:
QAYAMAT KI EK RATH AISI BHI AYI-
KAZA NEH SAKINA KO LOHRI SUNAI-
KAHA ROKE SAJJAD NE AY FUFI-
KE AB ROYEGI PHIR KABHI NA-
BAHUT RO CHUKI HAI SAKINA....
english translation text:
Then came one night of catastrophe
when death itself sang Sakina a lullaby.
Sajjad wept and said: O Aunt,
now she will never weep again.
Sakina has already wept so much.

arabic text:
JOH QABRE SAKINA PE ROTE THE QAIDI-
TOH UN RONE WALON SE BANOH YEH KEHTE-
ABHI THAK KE SOYI HAI ZINDAAN MEIN-
JAGANA ISE AB KOYI NA-
BAHUT RO CHUKI HAI SAKINA....
english translation text:
As the captives wept at Sakina’s grave,
Banu said to those who mourned:
She has only just fallen asleep in the prison;
let no one wake her now.
Sakina has already wept so much.

arabic text:
YEH KEHTA HAI "FARHAN" SE ROKAR "MAZHAR"-
JOH KABRE SAKINA PE JANA BARADAR-
WAHA MARSIYAH JAKE PADHNA YAHI-
BAHUT RO CHUKI HAI SAKINA-
english translation text:
‘Mazhar,’ Farhan says through tears:
Brother, when you visit Sakina’s grave,
recite this very elegy there:
Sakina has already wept so much.
